name: Model Profile Cache
description: Model profile cache: register sensitivity per model, pre-seeded from experiments. Stores and retrieves calibrated accuracy profiles for language models across different linguistic registers (direct, technical, academic, narrative, casual), with task-specific breakdowns and TTL-based expiration.

types.name: RegisterAccuracy

fields.name: task_type
fields.description: Task type identifier, empty string means aggregate across all tasks

types.description: Accuracy measurement for a specific register

fields.name: accuracies
fields.description: Accuracy measurements for each register in this task type

types.name: ModelProfile

fields.name: ttl_hours
fields.description: Time-to-live in hours before profile is considered expired

types.description: Complete calibration profile for a language model

types.name: ProfileCache

fields.name: _cache_dir
fields.description: Directory for cached profile JSON files

types.description: File-based cache for model register sensitivity profiles with in-memory layer and pre-seeded fallback

functions.name: TaskRegisterProfile.best_register
functions.description: Returns the register with highest accuracy for this task type. Defaults to 'direct' if no accuracies present.
postconditions: Returns 'direct' if self.accuracies is empty
Returns register name of maximum accuracy entry otherwise

functions.name: TaskRegisterProfile.spread_pp
functions.description: Computes accuracy spread in percentage points (max - min) * 100 for this task type.
postconditions: Returns 0.0 if self.accuracies is empty
Returns (max(accuracies) - min(accuracies)) * 100 otherwise

functions.name: ModelProfile.spread_pp
functions.description: Computes aggregate accuracy spread in percentage points (max - min) * 100 across all registers.
postconditions: Returns 0.0 if self.accuracies is empty
Returns (max(accuracies) - min(accuracies)) * 100 otherwise

functions.name: ModelProfile.is_invariant
functions.description: Determines if model performance is register-invariant (spread < 2 percentage points).
postconditions: Returns True if self.spread_pp < 2.0, False otherwise

functions.name: ModelProfile.best_register
functions.description: Returns the register with highest aggregate accuracy. Defaults to 'direct' if no accuracies present.
postconditions: Returns 'direct' if self.accuracies is empty
Returns register name of maximum accuracy entry otherwise

functions.name: ModelProfile.worst_register
functions.description: Returns the register with lowest aggregate accuracy. Defaults to 'direct' if no accuracies present.
postconditions: Returns 'direct' if self.accuracies is empty
Returns register name of minimum accuracy entry otherwise

functions.name: ModelProfile.best_register_for_task
functions.description: Get optimal register for a specific task type. Falls back to aggregate best_register if no per-task data.
postconditions: If matching TaskRegisterProfile found in self.by_task, returns its best_register
Otherwise returns self.best_register (aggregate)

functions.name: ModelProfile.spread_for_task
functions.description: Get register spread for a specific task type. Falls back to aggregate spread_pp if no per-task data.
postconditions: If matching TaskRegisterProfile found in self.by_task, returns its spread_pp
Otherwise returns self.spread_pp (aggregate)

functions.name: ModelProfile.is_expired
functions.description: Checks if profile has exceeded its TTL based on calibrated_at timestamp and ttl_hours.

error_cases.name: invalid_timestamp
error_cases.condition: calibrated_at cannot be parsed as ISO format datetime

postconditions: Returns False if calibrated_at is empty string
Returns False if datetime parsing fails (ValueError or TypeError)
Returns True if (now - calibrated_at) > ttl_hours, False otherwise
Assumes UTC timezone if calibrated_at has no timezone info
side_effects: Calls datetime.now(timezone.utc) to get current time

structured_side_effects.description: Reads current system time via datetime.now

functions.name: ProfileCache.__init__
functions.description: Initialize profile cache with optional custom cache directory. Defaults to ~/.transmogrifier/profiles.

inputs.name: cache_dir
inputs.description: Custom cache directory path, None for default

postconditions: self._cache_dir is set to cache_dir if provided, else Path.home() / '.transmogrifier' / 'profiles'
self._memory is initialized as empty dict

functions.name: ProfileCache.get
functions.description: Retrieve model profile by name with fallback chain: memory cache → file cache → pre-seeded → partial match. Checks expiration and updates memory cache on file load.
postconditions: Returns cached non-expired profile if found in memory
Returns non-expired profile from file cache and updates memory
Returns pre-seeded profile if canonical name matches
Returns pre-seeded profile on partial key match (substring)
Returns None if no match found in any tier
side_effects: Updates self._memory on successful file load

functions.name: ProfileCache.put
functions.description: Persist profile to disk cache and update memory cache. Creates cache directory if needed.
postconditions: Cache directory exists (created if missing)
Profile written to {cache_dir}/{model_name}.json as indented JSON
Profile stored in self._memory[profile.model_name]
Returns path to written file
side_effects: Creates cache directory if not exists

functions.name: ProfileCache.invalidate
functions.description: Remove profile from memory cache and delete file from disk if exists.
postconditions: Profile removed from self._memory if present
File deleted if exists at {cache_dir}/{canonical}.json
Returns True if file was deleted, False otherwise
side_effects: Deletes file from disk if exists

functions.name: ProfileCache.list_profiles
functions.description: Returns all available profiles from pre-seeded data plus non-duplicate cached files.

error_cases.name: parse_error
error_cases.condition: JSON parse or ModelProfile validation fails for cached file

postconditions: Returns list starting with all pre-seeded profiles
Appends profiles from *.json files in cache_dir that don't duplicate pre-seeded model_name
Silently skips files that fail JSON parsing or ModelProfile validation
side_effects: Reads all *.json files from cache directory

functions.name: ProfileCache._load_file
functions.description: Load profile from JSON file. Returns None on missing file or parse errors. Logs debug message on failure.

error_cases.name: parse_failure
error_cases.condition: JSON parse or ModelProfile validation fails

postconditions: Returns None if file does not exist
Returns ModelProfile instance if parse succeeds
Returns None and logs debug message if parse fails

structured_side_effects.description: Logs parse failure with path and exception

invariants: _PRESEEDED contains pre-calibrated profiles for claude-opus-4, claude-haiku-4-5, gpt-4o-mini, gemini-2-5-flash
_ALIASES maps versioned model IDs to canonical profile names
Default register fallback is 'direct' when no accuracies present
Invariance threshold is 2.0 percentage points spread

data_access.rationale: Caches model profiles as JSON files in ~/.transmogrifier/profiles, reads on lookup, writes on put/invalidate
